messages.text: Thursday, September 24 · Canton, Michigan
Autumn's first crisp air, jazz notes, and a town's future
A mostly clear Thursday arrives with crisp autumn air and a high near 70°F. Look for jazz performances in Ann Arbor and discussions on Ann Arbor's downtown property sale.
Expect a mostly clear day with a high near 70°F and a low around 51°F, with no chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:24 AM and sunset is at 7:27 PM, with the moon appearing as a waxing gibbous, 93.4% illuminated.
Ann Arbor's evening sounds and sights
For a taste of jazz, consider Fresh Berrys. at El Limon at 6:00 PM, or Pianist Barron Ryan at Kerrytown Concert House at 7:30 PM.
Evil Gigawatt's birthday is today, September 24.
Ann Arbor plans for downtown property sale funds
Ann Arbor City Council has approved a spending plan for the $14.2 million to $17.4 million expected from the sale of the city-owned Kline’s lot. The funds will be allocated to 12 different projects.
Friday brings film and music
Tomorrow, catch a free outdoor screening of 'Best in Show' at Campus Martius Park in Detroit, or attend Dolly Day at the Ann Arbor District Library.
Satellites navigate without GPS, new cancer treatment advances

NASA's Starling satellites have demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and star catalogs. The University of Michigan has established a $10 million Histotripsy Center to advance non-invasive cancer treatments using soundwaves.
The Starship launch schedule is unset, with no official date listed for its next attempt.
A clear sky offers many paths to discovery.
Friday, September 25 · Canton, Michigan
Autumn sky, full moon, and the sound of jazz

An overcast but mild autumn day offers a full moon tonight and a range of cultural events across the region. The local civic thread focuses on Ann Arbor's plans for downtown property sale funds, while science explores autonomous navigation for satellites.
Expect an overcast day with a high near 68°F and a low around 45°F, with a minimal chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:25 AM, sunset at 7:26 PM, and the nearly full moon, 97.6% illuminated, rises at 6:51 PM.
Friday's nearby sounds and sights

Ann Arbor's Kerrytown Concert House hosts pianist Barron Ryan at 6:30 PM for a blend of classical and cool jazz. In Detroit, the Dossin Great Lakes Museum offers an evening of live jazz and cocktails starting at 6:00 PM.
The autumn equilux, marking the point when day and night are nearly equal, occurs tomorrow.
Ann Arbor's strategy for downtown sale proceeds

Ann Arbor City Council has approved a plan to allocate between $14.2 million and $17.4 million from the sale of the Kline's lot. These funds will support 12 distinct projects, including affordable housing and sustainable energy initiatives.
Tomorrow's community and cultural offerings

Ypsilanti launches The Big Read at the Michigan Library Plaza at 11:00 AM, featuring performances and local history. Spinning Dot Theatre also presents "Mariposa/Butterfly" at YDL-Whittaker at 2:00 PM.
Satellites navigate without GPS, Roman telescope readies for launch

NASA's Starling satellites have successfully demonstrated GPS-free autonomous navigation using onboard cameras and star catalogs. The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has cleared its flight-readiness review, targeting a launch aboard Falcon Heavy.
The first orbital Starship launch attempt is estimated no earlier than September 18, 2026, according to independent schedules.
The evening invites a moment of quiet reflection under the moon.
